> •  A two-wheeled camera robot you can control with your phone.•   For the longest time I have wanted to create a remote-controlled car of some sort. Once I found out that with Half Club/Half-Life can help fund projects I went to work to brainstorm. My hope is that this can help me create a prototype for a two wheeled bot with which I can make for a local  tech I help host at my small school during the summer and if I can get this to work I would be really excited.   PicoScout1 is not just any robot but I wanted a small robot that can be good to use for tech camp or anyone really but my plan is to make it so that I can control it with a phone and be able to move the robot and see what the camera sees which can make for some fun for really anyone to play with *If it works*. This is my first project with Hack Club but it will not be my first but second PCB I designed yet motors will be a new thing for me. Also Week 1 ends up also being when I have a break off of school so I can devote more time upfront.
